title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Fourteen Thousand Four Hundred Pesos to be Paid as Compensation to the Widow of the Late Representative Pedro Lopez
title.orig: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Fourteen Thousand Four Hundred Pesos to be Paid as Compensation to the Widow of the Late Representative Pedro Lopez

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1783_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, the sum of fourteen thousand four hundred pesos is appropriated to be paid as compensation to the widow of the late Representative Pedro Lopez. This amount shall be exempt from all kinds of taxes.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1957.
